Name: Place Fish Tanks Outside (Furniture Anywhere Redux) by glymr
Author: glymr
TagLine: Place vanilla fish tank furniture outside! Includes the Large, Small, Deluxe, Modern, and Aquatic Sanctuary fish tanks. Works with Alternative Textures and Content Patcher versions!
Description:
This mod allows the player to place any vanilla fish tank outside. It currently affects these fish tanks:

Large Fish Tank
Small Fish Tank
Deluxe Fish Tank
Modern Fish Tank
Aquatic Sanctuary

Yes, it works with Alternative Textures and Content Patcher! If you have a different skin for any of these fish tanks, it should show up in the game! (Though skins designed to work inside the house might look odd outside.)

The fish tanks do light up automatically when it gets dark, the same as when they're inside.

Thanks to Ham on the main SDV Discord for suggesting I make fish tanks placeable outside.

If there is interest, I would like to create more mods that allow the placement of Vanilla furniture outside. If I try to do the entire furniture catalog at once, I know I will never finish, but I can do a few at a time or a category at a time. Therefore, if there is a particular item or set of items you would like to be able to place outside, please leave a polite request in the comments and I will see about making them work. (Some items can already be placed outside, so please verify that you can't before asking.)

If you like this mod, I hope you will endorse it. Thank you!

---
